description:
SpaceX successfully launched Starship Flight Test 15 from Starbase, Texas, and was able to get the ship into orbit, where it deployed 26 Starlink satellites. The Super Heavy Booster booster splashed down off the coast of the Gulf of Mexico, and SpaceX will attempt to catch Starship back on its launchpad on Saturday, Nov 14, in the afternoon.
